name: canvas-study-assistant
title_zh: 学生视角的 Canvas 课业管家，不点头不交作业
tagline_zh: 把课程、模块、作业、考试截止日摊开成一张可执行清单；草稿改到满意才交，老师端功能一概不碰，省得误操作。
tagline_en: Turns Canvas modules, quizzes, and deadlines into an actionable study plan; drafts stay drafts until you.
desc_en: Use Canvas LMS as a student to discover course content, modules, syllabus, pages, quizzes, discussions, assignments and deadlines; plan study work; download materials; collaborate on drafts; and submit only after explicit confirmation. Do not use for teacher, grading, or course-administration workflows.
why_zh: 它只站在学生这一侧：从课程内容到截止日全自动梳理，协作草稿与提交之间设一道人工确认闸门。
why_en: It's built solely for the student seat: auto-aggregates content and deadlines, and hard-wires a human-approval gate between.
limit_zh: 仅限学生身份使用，不处理评分、成绩册或课程管理；需要学校 Canvas 实例开放 API 访问；只读与提交动作。
limit_en: Student-only; no grading, gradebook, or admin workflows. Requires your institution's Canvas API access. Reads and submits only—won't generate.
title_en: Canvas student assistant that never submits without your OK
